Prescription drug costs are simply too high. @SenGillibrand is advancing legislation to make sure people don’t have to decide between rent, groceries & medication. NY’s Healthcare & Mental Hygiene Worker Bonus is now open!

I was a strong advocate for these bonuses of up $3,000

For any questions or assistance - contact my office immediately at 315-428-7632 or mannion@nysenate.gov https://t.co/jB2xMJ48qT
